rectangular_positional_interpolation.implementation: Built-in learned patch positional embeddings are reshaped to their square training grid and interpolated to (height // patch_height, width // patch_width).

budget_policy.status: experimental choices; not established optimal values

evaluation_policy.leave_one_out: 1-nearest eligible reference using the same condition
evaluation_policy.tie_resolution: smallest numerical reference ID; tie_flag remains true
